Today in the park

The pass usually runs about 20 degrees colder than the lake, so check both temperatures before you pick a trail, and check sunset before you pick a long one. Tracks are easiest to find first thing in the morning, in the mud along the Lakeshore Loop.

Updated every morning by 6 at the lodge front desk and both entrance stations.
